data.title:
50% extra trade credit towards New Releases
					New Release titles are eligible up to two weeks after launch
data.fineprint: In store only. Eligible titles are for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X & PS5. Offer valid only towards games normally accepted in trade. Games must include original cases and artwork. Extra trade should cover up to the cost of the game purchased. Extra trade is to be put towards new release games. Cannot be combined with any other trade offer including EDGE. No duplicate titles accepted. Trades must be in full working condition to receive full value. Subject to Manager approval. Offer subject to change at any time.

data.title: 25% Extra trade for games towards Digital
data.fineprint: In store only. Applies only to PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X, Xbox One Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2 software traded towards digital codes for games and content, subscription services, currency/wallet funds and posa cards. Total trade value cannot exceed cost of purchase. Cannot be combined with any other trade offer. Trades must be in full working condition to receive full value. Trades are subject to Manager approval. Refurbishment fee may apply. No substitutions will be made. No rainchecks. Offer subject to change at any time.

data.title: Buy 2 Used Games Get 1 Free
data.fineprint: In store only. Cannot be combined with any other offers. Cannot be combined with EDGE. Applies to Used games. Excludes NSW 2 games. Applies to Used game that is of lowest value. Quantity and selection may vary by store. Offer subject to change at any time. No substitutions will be made. No rainchecks.
